prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Your pet is live on your desktop! Use the taskbar tray icon to manage visibility, wake, or interact with your companion.", "Tray Control Reference", "Click the taskbar icon anytime to hide or bring back your pet."]
1: ["Sign In to Keep Your Companion Safe", "Signing in links your pet safely to your cloud profile so your companion is never lost across sessions.", "Existing profile detected! Sign in with your registered account to restore your pet.", "Cloud Save Active"]
2: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Review your companion's identity and confirm adoption to proceed.", "Official Pet Identity Verified"]
3: ["Desktop Launch Verification", "Your pet generation is complete! Confirming display rendering and taskbar placement.", "Launch Desktop Companion", "Render Verified", "If pet does not appear, check your system tray icon."]
4: ["Choose Preset for instant fun or Custom for unique photo-based creation. Both offer full interactions!"]
5: ["Your Desktop Pet is Ready in the System Tray", "Look for the pet icon in your taskbar tray to interact, open options, or toggle desktop visibility at any time."]
6: ["Your companion is being rendered in the background. Feel free to use other apps while waiting!"]
7: ["Use clear, well-lit photos with distinct subjects for the best pet generation results."]
8: ["Welcome Back! Sign In to Restore Your Pets", "Your adoptable companions and account data are saved to your profile and will restore instantly."]
9: ["Select Your Adoption Journey"]
